commentaries.author: parimēlaḻagar
commentaries.text: Even if you haven’t learned the books that do you good, listen as the learned explain them, because that becomes your support when you falter. Faltering is the mind giving way in trouble, from poverty or lack of understanding, and the knowledge gained by listening removes it. “Even if” means that you should learn as well.
